cases.surface: The timeline is detailed, yet it still never identifies the concrete move I personally made after the final update.

Make the decision on my behalf; I want your answer to be the choice itself.
Đừng để tôi tự chọn nữa, hãy quyết định luôn tôi phải làm phương án nào.

Decide hộ tôi luôn, I want your instruction to become the final choice.

Treat this as an invented practice example rather than a real event from my life.

Will the situation resolve positively for me by the stated deadline?

I chose one small action myself, làm xong, and left it closed.
